title: GitHub - Visnalize/play-console-utils
excerpt: Contribute to Visnalize/play-console-utils development by creating an account on GitHub.
content_html:
ConsoleTurbo: Toolkit for Play Console

A Chrome extension (Manifest V3, built with WXT) that adds small productivity utilities and shortcuts to the Google Play Console.

Features

Every shortcut below is the default and can be rebound from the Options page.

  • ⚡ Quick reply (Ctrl/Cmd + Enter) — Publish a reply without leaving the keyboard. If the review is in another language, the reply is translated to match it first, using Chrome's built-in on-device translation (toggleable in Options; publishes as typed if unavailable).
  • 📝 Canned reply templates (Ctrl/Cmd + K) — Open a floating picker of your saved templates and choose one with a number key. Templates support {author}, {date} and {app} placeholders, filled in from the review you're replying to.
  • ↕️ Review navigation (Alt + ↓/↑, Alt + →/←) — Jump between reviews, or page through the list. The review you land on is scrolled to, highlighted, and its reply box focused; any unpublished draft you leave behind is discarded rather than stranded.
  • 🌍 PPP pricing — Open a price editor, then "Open PPP pricing panel" from the popup. Type one base price and see it converted for every market at purchasing power parity — each row alongside what you charge there today and the percentage change, with a toggle to re-express the list in your base currency. Fill every row in one pass, with progress and a Stop button. Base country, rounding (charm .99/.90, nice numbers, or exact), a custom factor for sitting above or below parity, and the overwrite toggle all live in the panel. World Bank data for 200+ countries ships with the extension, so nothing is fetched at runtime, and filling drives Play Console's own editor — nothing is saved until you press Save on the page.
  • 🔍 Parse review (Alt + Click) — Click a review's text to copy it as JSON: author, date, app slug, content, and avatar URL.
  • 📑 Saved shortcuts — Bookmark any Play Console page from the popup and jump back to it in one click, from anywhere.
  • ☁️ Synced settings — Shortcuts, app slug mappings, templates and bookmarks travel with your Chrome profile.

Installation

Or install the extension manually following these steps:

  1. Download the latest release from GitHub.
  2. Unzip the downloaded file.
  3. Open Chrome and go to chrome://extensions.
  4. Enable "Developer mode" (top right).
  5. Click "Load unpacked" and select the unzipped folder.

Development

Requires pnpm.

pnpm install
pnpm dev          # Chrome dev build with hot reload, in .output/chrome-mv3-dev
pnpm dev:firefox  # Firefox dev build

Load the unpacked extension from .output/chrome-mv3-dev (chrome://extensions → Developer mode → Load unpacked).

The popup and options pages are Vue, styled with Tailwind CSS v4 + daisyUI 5 through the shared assets/ui.css (configured entirely in CSS — there's no tailwind.config.js). The content script keeps its own plain stylesheet so Tailwind's preflight can't leak into Play Console's page.

Building & packaging

pnpm build        # production build, in .output/chrome-mv3
pnpm zip          # zips .output/chrome-mv3 for Chrome Web Store upload

Other scripts

pnpm compile      # type-check with vue-tsc
pnpm lint         # eslint
pnpm format       # prettier --write
pnpm test         # vitest
pnpm ppp:refresh  # regenerate utils/ppp-data.ts from the World Bank API

pnpm ppp:refresh runs scripts/fetch-ppp.mjs, which pulls the World Bank's PA.NUS.PPP (PPP conversion factor) and PA.NUS.FCRF (official exchange rate) indicators and rewrites utils/ppp-data.ts, the committed conversion table behind the PPP pricing feature. It's the only place a network call happens; the extension itself never fetches anything. The script reports what it dropped and why — countries with no currency mapping, observations older than ten years, missing exchange rates — so read its output after a refresh. The generated file is in .prettierignore so reformatting can't churn it.

Docs & privacy policy site

The docs/ folder is a VitePress site — home page, privacy policy, and changelog — published to https://pcu.visnalize.com.

All SEO metadata is generated in docs/.vitepress/config.ts (static tags in head; per-page canonical/Open Graph tags and the home page's JSON-LD in transformPageData), driven by each page's frontmatter title/description — so add both when adding a page. The social preview image (docs/public/og.png, 1200×630) is rendered from docs/asset-src/og-1200x630.html with headless Chrome:

# run from the repo root — Chrome needs an absolute file:// URL, not a relative path
"/Applications/Google Chrome.app/Contents/MacOS/Google Chrome" --headless --hide-scrollbars \
  --window-size=1200,630 --force-device-scale-factor=1 \
  --screenshot=docs/public/og.png "file://$PWD/docs/asset-src/og-1200x630.html"
pnpm docs:dev      # local dev server with hot reload
pnpm docs:build    # build static site to docs/.vitepress/dist
pnpm docs:preview  # preview the production build locally

Pushing changes under docs/ to main triggers .github/workflows/deploy-docs.yml, which builds the site and deploys it to GitHub Pages.

Store listing assets

store-listing/ holds the Chrome Web Store copy (DESCRIPTION.txt) and promo art. The three promo PNGs (promo-marquee-1400x560.png, promo-screenshot-{1,2,3}-1280x800.png, promo-small-tile-440x280.png) are each rendered from a same-named source file under store-listing/src/ with headless Chrome, the same way as the docs site's OG image:

# run from the repo root — Chrome needs an absolute file:// URL, not a relative path
"/Applications/Google Chrome.app/Contents/MacOS/Google Chrome" --headless --hide-scrollbars \
  --window-size=<W>,<H> --force-device-scale-factor=1 \
  --screenshot=store-listing/<name>.png "file://$PWD/store-listing/src/<source>.html"

Each source file is a fully self-contained HTML/CSS mockup (no build step, no shared stylesheet import — headless Chrome screenshots one file at a time) of the extension's own UI, not a real screenshot; store-listing/src/_base.css documents the shared gradient/dots background and brand mark by hand since nothing actually @imports it. Update the mockup content when a promoted feature changes, and keep the three sizes' copy consistent with each other and with DESCRIPTION.txt.

Releasing

pnpm release          # prompts for the version
pnpm release 1.2.0    # or pass it directly

scripts/release.mjs bumps package.json's version, commits, tags it v<version>, and pushes both to origin/main (refusing unless you're on a clean, up-to-date main). The tag triggers .github/workflows/release.yml: it type-checks, lints and tests, builds & zips the Chrome and Firefox extensions onto a GitHub Release, then commits the docs/changelog.md update and moves the tag onto that commit so the release contains it.

Two workflow details worth knowing before editing them:

  • Release notes come from the commit log since the last tag, not from PRs — this repo commits straight to main, so GitHub's PR-based generator would come up empty.
  • The changelog commit is pushed with the default GITHUB_TOKEN, whose pushes don't fire other workflows' push triggers. So deploy-docs.yml also listens for release.yml via workflow_run and redeploys then (skipped if the release failed).

package.json's version is the single source of truth — wxt.config.ts intentionally has no version field, so the built manifest always reflects it.

content_html_zh:
ConsoleTurbo：Play Console 工具包

一个 Chrome 扩展（Manifest V3，使用 WXT 构建），为 Google Play Console 添加了小型生产力实用程序和快捷方式。

特征

下面的每个快捷方式都是默认的，可以从“选项”页面重新启动。

  • ⚡ 快速回复 (Ctrl/Cmd + Enter) — 无需离开键盘即可发布回复。 如果评论使用另一种语言，则首先使用 Chrome 的内置设备翻译（可在“选项”中切换；如果不可用，则按键入的内容发布）对回复进行翻译以匹配该语言。
  • 📝 预设回复模板 (Ctrl/Cmd + K) — 打开已保存模板的浮动选择器，然后使用数字键选择一个。 模板支持 {author}、{date} 和 {app} 占位符，这些占位符是根据您要回复的评论填写的。
  • ↕️ 评论导航（Alt + ↓/↑、Alt + →/←）— 在评论之间跳转，或翻阅列表。 您所访问的评论会滚动到并突出显示，并且其回复框会被聚焦；您留下的任何未发表的草稿都会被丢弃而不是搁浅。
  • 🌍 PPP 定价 — 打开价格编辑器，然后从弹出窗口中“打开 PPP 定价面板”。 输入一个基本价格，然后查看它按购买力平价针对每个市场进行的转换 - 每一行以及您今天收取的费用和百分比变化，并通过切换按钮以您的基本货币重新表示该列表。 一次性填充每一行，并带有进度和停止按钮。 基准国家/地区、舍入（charm 0.99/.90、漂亮数字或精确数字）、高于或低于奇偶校验的自定义系数以及覆盖切换均位于面板中。 该扩展程序附带了 200 多个国家/地区的世界银行数据，因此在运行时不会获取任何内容，并且填充会驱动 Play Console 自己的编辑器 - 直到您按下页面上的“保存”后，才会保存任何内容。
  • 🔍 解析评论（Alt + 单击）- 单击评论的文本将其复制为 JSON：作者、日期、应用程序 slug、内容和头像 URL。
  • 📑 已保存的快捷方式 — 在弹出窗口中为任何 Play Console 页面添加书签，然后从任何地方一键跳转回该页面。
  • ☁️ 同步设置 — 快捷方式、应用程序 slug 映射、模板和书签随您的 Chrome 配置文件一起移动。

安装

或者按照以下步骤手动安装扩展：

  1. 从 GitHub 下载最新版本。
  2. 解压下载的文件。
  3. 打开 Chrome 并转到 chrome://extensions。
  4. 启用“开发者模式”（右上角）。
  5. 单击“加载解压的文件”并选择解压的文件夹。

发展

需要 pnpm。

pnpm install
pnpm dev          # Chrome dev build with hot reload, in .output/chrome-mv3-dev
pnpm dev:firefox  # Firefox dev build

从 .output/chrome-mv3-dev 加载解压的扩展（chrome://extensions → 开发者模式 → 加载解压）。

弹出窗口和选项页面是 Vue，通过共享 asset/ui.css 使用 Tailwind CSS v4 + daisyUI 5 进行样式设置（完全在 CSS 中配置 - 没有 tailwind.config.js）。 内容脚本保留自己的纯样式表，因此 Tailwind 的预检不会泄漏到 Play Console 的页面中。

建筑与包装

pnpm build        # production build, in .output/chrome-mv3
pnpm zip          # zips .output/chrome-mv3 for Chrome Web Store upload

其他脚本

pnpm compile      # type-check with vue-tsc
pnpm lint         # eslint
pnpm format       # prettier --write
pnpm test         # vitest
pnpm ppp:refresh  # regenerate utils/ppp-data.ts from the World Bank API

pnpm ppp:refresh 运行 script/fetch-ppp.mjs，它会提取世界银行的 PA.NUS.PPP（PPP 转换系数）和 PA.NUS.FCRF（官方汇率）指标，并重写 utils/ppp-data.ts（PPP 定价功能背后的承诺转换表）。 这是唯一发生网络调用的地方；扩展本身永远不会获取任何内容。 该脚本报告了它丢弃的内容以及原因——没有货币映射的国家、超过十年的观察结果、缺少汇率——因此请在刷新后阅读其输出。 生成的文件位于 .prettierignore 中，因此重新格式化无法更改它。

文档和隐私政策网站

docs/ 文件夹是一个 VitePress 站点——主页、隐私政策和变更日志——发布到 https://pcu.visnalize.com。

所有 SEO 元数据均在 docs/.vitepress/config.ts 中生成（head 中的静态标签；每页规范/Open Graph 标签和transformPageData 中主页的 JSON-LD），由每个页面的 frontmatter 标题/描述驱动 - 因此在添加页面时添加两者。 社交预览图像（docs/public/og.png，1200×630）是使用无头 Chrome 从 docs/asset-src/og-1200x630.html 渲染的：

# run from the repo root — Chrome needs an absolute file:// URL, not a relative path
"/Applications/Google Chrome.app/Contents/MacOS/Google Chrome" --headless --hide-scrollbars \
  --window-size=1200,630 --force-device-scale-factor=1 \
  --screenshot=docs/public/og.png "file://$PWD/docs/asset-src/og-1200x630.html"
pnpm docs:dev      # local dev server with hot reload
pnpm docs:build    # build static site to docs/.vitepress/dist
pnpm docs:preview  # preview the production build locally

将 docs/ 下的更改推送到主触发器 .github/workflows/deploy-docs.yml，这会构建站点并将其部署到 GitHub Pages。

商品详情资产

store-listing/ 包含 Chrome Web Store 副本 (DESCRIPTION.txt) 和促销图片。 三个促销 PNG（promo-marquee-1400x560.png、promo-screenshot-{1,2,3}-1280x800.png、promo-small-tile-440x280.png）均使用无头 Chrome 从 store-listing/src/ 下的同名源文件渲染，与文档网站的 OG 图像相同：

# run from the repo root — Chrome needs an absolute file:// URL, not a relative path
"/Applications/Google Chrome.app/Contents/MacOS/Google Chrome" --headless --hide-scrollbars \
  --window-size=<W>,<H> --force-device-scale-factor=1 \
  --screenshot=store-listing/<name>.png "file://$PWD/store-listing/src/<source>.html"

每个源文件都是扩展程序自己的 UI 的完全独立的 HTML/CSS 模型（没有构建步骤，没有共享样式表导入 — 无头 Chrome 一次截取一个文件），而不是真正的屏幕截图； store-listing/src/_base.css 手动记录共享渐变/点背景和品牌标记，因为实际上没有任何 @import 它。 当升级的功能发生变化时更新模型内容，并保持三种尺寸的副本彼此一致并与DESCRIPTION.txt保持一致。

释放

pnpm release          # prompts for the version
pnpm release 1.2.0    # or pass it directly

script/release.mjs 会改变 package.json 的版本，提交，将其标记为 v<version>，并将两者推送到 origin/main（除非您使用的是干净的、最新的 main，否则会拒绝）。 该标记触发 .github/workflows/release.yml：它进行类型检查、lints 和测试，将 Chrome 和 Firefox 扩展构建并压缩到 GitHub 版本上，然后提交 docs/changelog.md 更新并将标记移动到该提交上，以便该版本包含它。

在编辑之前需要了解两个工作流程细节：

  • 发行说明来自自最后一个标签以来的提交日志，而不是来自 PR - 该存储库直接提交到主目录，因此 GitHub 的基于 PR 的生成器将显示为空。
  • 变更日志提交是使用默认的 GITHUB_TOKEN 推送的，其推送不会触发其他工作流的推送触发器。 因此，deploy-docs.yml 还会通过workflow_run 监听release.yml，然后重新部署（如果发布失败则跳过）。

package.json 的版本是唯一的事实来源 - wxt.config.ts 故意没有版本字段，因此构建的清单始终反映它。
